description: Save a reusable Studio prompt in a project: a named bundle of {system_prompt, model, settings, reference_media_ids}. Returns its `public_id` ("prompt_…") — reference it later as "prompt:<public_id>" (stable) or "prompt.<name>" (within this project) on gate_media_generate / chat. 409 if the name exists.

model.description: Default model id to apply when this prompt is used.

name.description: Unique name within the project (used by "prompt.<name>").

project_id.description: Studio project uuid the prompt belongs to.

settings.description: Saved parameter VALUES (temperature, top_p, media params, …).

system_prompt.description: The system prompt / generation text to store.

name: gate_prompt_create
